events.title: I Bid You Welcome… To Our Public Demo! | Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen Demo
events.summary: The wait is over! We're excited to announce that the demo for ‘Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen’ is now publicly available on Steam! After months of work behind the scenes, the time has finally come for everyone to step into the darkness, experience the story, and discover what awaits them. Whether you've been following development for a while or are just discovering the game, we'd love for you to join us, play the demo, and let us know what you think! events.title: Harrowed World Shrouded 2025 – End of Year Reflection
events.summary: Another year at an end. It’s been a long year, personally especially. As many of you may know, near the start of this year I lost my mum to cancer. With that tragic loss, came many changes, that I’m still adjusting to. From new financial restraints to a very different Christmas period. I share this not to garner sympathy, but simply to explain my current situation. I’m not a big sharer but at the same time I’m not big with secrets either. events.title: Introduction with a Vampire – Harrowed World Vampires Explained
events.summary: Watch the video or read the transcript below:Well, I hate to break it to you but you’re dead.At least you were briefly.What you are now, it’s a little harder to say. Simply put you’re a vampire.Risen from legend into the cold dark night.We call ourselves Vetostryx, after the undead emperors of old. It’s Time To Believe In Monsters, because you are one. events.title: Harrowed World Tabletop – Dark New Era of TTRPG Begins
events.summary: Harrowed World is taking a bold step into the realm of dice, character sheets, and imagination. Work has officially begun on a tabletop roleplaying game adaptation of the dark gothic setting, tentatively titled Harrowed World Tabletop. While the name may change as development progresses, the project promises to deliver an immersive experience that captures the haunting beauty and deep depths of Harrowed World in a new way.
